company.description: Pixis provides a codeless AI infrastructure platform for brands to monitor and orchestrate their marketing campaigns. The company's AI technology is also developed for growth marketing and has a rich product suite that includes targeting, in-flight performance optimization, and generative AI capabilities.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $85,000,000, or 40.67% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $12,023,372 to $809,534,381, a 67.33x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
